_labelling_rule: ANS: a concrete fact literally in the named doc; _anchor_phrase = a verbatim substring for gold resolution; answer_must_mention = whole-token any-of slots encoding the correct fact. REF (should_refuse): a plausible question whose specific answer is absent from BOTH corpus docs -> the system must refuse.
_source_note: Source PDFs are public-domain US-government works (17 USC 105), kept LOCAL (never committed); only this query set + the baseline ship. Authored by an adversarially-verified multi-agent pass, then resolved + live-eval-validated.

queries.question: What launch date does the document set for the James Webb Space Telescope?

queries.question: What magnitude of dike intrusion did Donaldson and others (2017) attribute to the S-wave-splitting changes at Mount Ruapehu?
queries._expected_answer: Absent / conflated: the 10-km-long dike inference at Mount Ruapehu's 1998 eruption is attributed to Miller and Savage (2001) and Gerst and Savage (2004), not Donaldson and others (2017), who studied seismic velocity vs tilt at Kilauea; the question merges two unrelated studies, so the specific claim is not stated.
